question: 今年通过直缴方式缴款的资金总额是多少？
sql: SELECT dateTrunc('YEAR', toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate)) AS metric_time__year, sum(paybook_full_high.famt) AS "非税缴款金额" FROM yunnan0508.fne_paybook_full_high AS paybook_full_high WHERE paybook_full_high.fbustype = '1' AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY dateTrunc('YEAR', toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate)) SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
